name: TurboUSD Node
_comment: DISCRETE parts, deliberately NOT one merged blob at 0x0: a merged image spans the NVS partition at 0x9000 and fills it with 0xFF, wiping saved WiFi credentials on EVERY web re-flash (even without 'erase'). Flashing the parts at their real offsets leaves the NVS region untouched, so updates keep WiFi + settings. Offsets match firmware-esp32/partitions.csv: bootloader 0x0, partition table 0x8000 (32768), boot_app0 0xe000 (57344), app 0x10000 (65536). All four files are published by the CI release workflow and served same-origin via web/app/firmware/[file]/route.ts (GitHub asset URLs lack CORS headers).
